page_title: LEN 2-0 REI | Lens v Reims 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
90+7' Reims force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Ibrahim Diakite (Reims) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went well wide of the left post.
90+4' A player from Lens takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Reims.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Andy Diouf (Lens) coming on for Salis Abdul Samed.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Reims take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski is replaced by Faitout Maouassa (Lens).
88' The game is interrupted now, Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' Francois Letexier interrupts the game. One of the players from Reims won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
85' A substitution has been made. Emmanuel Agbadou is replaced by Ibrahim Diakite (Reims).
85' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Azor Matusiwa will be replaced by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
85' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
80' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Here is a change. Mohamed Daramy is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to Oumar Diakite (Reims).
78' Substitution. Amir Richardson (Reims) replaces Reda Khadra.
78' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Lens players have a reason to celebrate!
77' The Lens players halt their celebrations as referee Francois Letexier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
75' 2 - 0 Ruben Aguilar showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Oscar Cortes (Lens) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 2:0.
73' The Reims players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
68' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Salama (Reims) replacing Keito Nakamura.
65' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Wesley Said and he is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
65' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. David Costa (Lens) replaces Angelo Fulgini.
65' Substitution. Oscar Cortes (Lens) on for Adrien Thomasson.
61' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Adrien Thomasson (Lens) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
60' Lens earn a corner.
59' Wesley Said (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
52' A dangerous towering header by Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
52' Reims win a corner.
52' Junya Ito (Reims) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
50' Teddy Teuma (Reims) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
46' What a huge chance for Junya Ito (Reims). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
46' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+3' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+3' Francois Letexier blows the whistle, Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is penalised for a foul. Reims win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Wesley Said (Lens), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
42' Keito Nakamura (Reims) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
41' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Wesley Said (Lens) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
37' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is penalised for holding. Francois Letexier signals a set piece. Lens have a free kick.
37' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is penalised for holding. Francois Letexier signals a set piece.
33' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) sends the corner into the box, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts it and averts the threat.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
27' Teddy Teuma (Reims) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' A yellow card for a tackle by Azor Matusiwa (Reims). Francois Letexier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
20' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Reims players look gutted.
19' Reims score a goal, but referee Francois Letexier has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
18' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) has a goal ruled out for offside!
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lens, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the left post and ricochets away!
16' Reims force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' Keito Nakamura (Reims) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Brice Samba has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
14' Massadio Haidara (Lens) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Reims will take a free kick near the side line.
13' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lens was in an offside position.
10' Reims couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Brice Samba (Lens) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
9' A player from Lens brings down an opponent and commits a foul. It's a free kick to Reims, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
8' The corner from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is intercepted by Brice Samba.

7' A great run by Junya Ito (Reims) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Reims will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Reims, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Reims have been awarded a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Reims will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
